brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors detected. The doctor obtained BP values and symptoms, screened for wound infection risks, addressed medication uncertainty with clear safety boundaries, acknowledged document limitations, distinguished preoperative from postoperative tasks, provided a concrete action plan with owners/timing/triggers, and verified family understanding. At least two high-order points completed: HO1 (BP verification through rest/repeat measurement context) and HO4 (bounded closure with residual uncertainties named).

citations.explanation: Final doctor message confirms daily monitoring plan, pathology tracking starting day 3, one-week follow-up regardless of pathology status, and clear escalation triggers
citations.quote: 您现在已经把最难的两层都稳住了，今晚让他睡，您也歇一下，明天有事再告诉我。

closure_assessment.explanation: Closure is bounded with explicit residual uncertainties named (pathology pending, BP monitoring ongoing), clear owners (surgery clinic for follow-up, family for home monitoring), emergency triggers, and family receipt confirmed through teach-back
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure

actionability_responsibility_chain.explanation: Doctor provides explicit four-point communication script for ED triage including BP reading, wound status, medications, and specific requests
actionability_responsibility_chain.quote: 在分诊台跟护士和医生沟通时，请您清晰讲出四件事

clinical_reasoning_direction.explanation: Doctor correctly interprets high BP in context of postoperative pain, stress, and possible missed dose rather than immediately escalating
clinical_reasoning_direction.quote: 这个血压读数虽然非常高，但没有伴随神经系统症状或胸痛、气短，更像应激+体位/休息不充分

continuity_memory_focus.explanation: Doctor documents internal note tracking BP trend from ED through home monitoring, medication reconciliation status, and pending pathology
continuity_memory_focus.quote: 保存一条医生工作备注：本次为背部脂肪瘤切除术后居家照护，家属执行能力好，血压在150-160/90-100区间波动

medical_safety_risk_recognition.explanation: Doctor provides clear thresholds for emergency return including specific BP values and symptom list
medical_safety_risk_recognition.quote: 血压持续≥180/110，或休息后反复≥160/100且越来越不稳

patient_family_realworld_adaptation.explanation: Doctor gives practical sleep positioning instructions adapted to back wound location
patient_family_realworld_adaptation.quote: 往没有切口的那一侧侧着睡，用枕头在背后和膝盖弯稍微垫一下

citations.explanation: Doctor asks about measurement technique, requests 15-minute rest and repeat measurement to verify reliability before escalating
citations.quote: 让他靠坐在有靠背的椅子上，双腿不交叉，脚平放地面，安静歇15分钟

citations.explanation: Doctor explains that first reading may be unreliable due to movement/stress and uses verification result to adjust triage plan
citations.quote: 他刚从车上下来没多久，可能没坐够，也有点紧张

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 completed: Doctor identified that initial BP might be unreliable (post-car, stress, pain), requested standardized rest and repeat measurement, and used the verified result to determine the appropriate urgency level

HO2 not triggered: Family did not express specific misconceptions about preoperative vs postoperative tasks or lipoma meaning cancer. The doctor proactively distinguished document categories but this was not in response to a surfaced misunderstanding

citations.explanation: Doctor escalates from home monitoring to ED referral when repeat BP remains critically elevated at 184/112
citations.quote: 您现在立刻准备去最近的急诊

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO3 completed: After initial home monitoring advice, new information (persistently elevated BP at 184/112) triggered explicit reprioritization from routine wound paperwork sorting to urgent ED evaluation, with clear reasoning provided

citations.explanation: Doctor explicitly separates closed issues from pending items: pathology pending, BP monitoring ongoing, follow-up scheduled
citations.quote: 病理从第3个工作日开始隔一两天查；一周左右不管病理出没出都回手术科看伤口

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms bounded closure with residual uncertainties named and family teach-back received
citations.quote: 您现在已经把最难的两层都稳住了

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO4 completed: Doctor provided bounded closure explicitly classifying safe home monitoring (current BP/wound status), pending verification (pathology, document clarity), emergency triggers, and ownership of each thread

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defect identified. All five dimensions achieved good or excellent ratings. The trajectory maintained appropriate clinical reasoning, recognized safety risks, provided actionable plans, adapted to family context, and maintained continuity.

citations.explanation: Doctor requests specific BP values, measurement timing, repeat after rest, and screens for end-organ symptoms
citations.quote: 让他靠坐在有靠背的椅子上...安静歇15分钟...再量一次

citations.explanation: Doctor explicitly asks about dangerous symptoms: chest pain, dyspnea, neurologic deficits
citations.quote: 没有胸闷、气短、脸歪、一边手脚无力、说话大舌头这些危险信号

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC1 met: Doctor obtained specific BP values, requested repeat measurement after rest, and systematically screened for hypertensive emergency symptoms including headache, chest pain, dyspnea, neurologic changes, and visual disturbances

citations.explanation: Doctor asks about wound drainage, bleeding, and infection signs
citations.quote: 敷料外面渗出变大、湿透、有明显脓血或臭味，或体温超过38.3℃

citations.explanation: Doctor provides explicit wound monitoring parameters during ED observation
citations.quote: 如果伤口敷料外面突然湿透、渗血变大、或者闻到脓臭味，马上告诉护士

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC2 met: Doctor systematically assessed wound status (drainage, bleeding, infection signs), asked about fever, and provided clear instructions for wound-related emergencies

citations.explanation: Doctor advises against self-adjusting medications before confirming with physician
citations.quote: 绝不能随便补吃降压药
在急诊医生看完药盒、发话之前，不要自己给他吃任何降压药或止痛药

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC3 met: Doctor identified medication uncertainty, advised against autonomous dose changes, recommended obtaining clear medication list, and coordinated with ED for medication reconciliation

citations.explanation: Doctor explicitly acknowledges blurred photos are unreliable
citations.quote: 您拍的出院纸照片确实太糊了，里面的术前检查、用药、换药医嘱我看不清

citations.explanation: Doctor requests clearer photos or reading aloud
citations.quote: 您需要重新拍清楚（或者趁光线好时一张一张读出来）

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC4 met: Doctor recognized document limitations, explicitly stated the photos were unreliable, and requested clearer images or alternative verification paths

citations.explanation: Doctor clarifies that preoperative tests are not home tasks and confirms current executable items are wound care and BP monitoring
citations.quote: 早晚量血压记下来，敷料每天看有没有变大变湿变红变热

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC5 met: Doctor distinguished preoperative evaluations from current home actions, focusing family on wound monitoring and BP measurement rather than repeating old test orders

citations.explanation: Doctor provides explicit emergency threshold and action
citations.quote: 如果血压仍然在180/110或以上...直接去最近的急诊

citations.explanation: Doctor assigns owners and timing for follow-up
citations.quote: 一周左右不管病理出没出都回手术科看伤口/拆线或继续换药

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC6 met: Doctor provided concrete plan with specific thresholds for emergency return, timing for BP monitoring, follow-up owner (surgery clinic), and fallback paths

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms family understanding through teach-back
citations.quote: 一周左右不管病理出没出都回手术科看伤口/拆线或继续换药

citations.explanation: Family demonstrates comprehension by restating the plan correctly
citations.quote: 一周左右不管病理出没出都照样去手术科复诊，不用等病理先出来再去

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC7 met: Doctor verified family understanding through teach-back; family correctly restated monitoring plan, emergency triggers, and follow-up timeline
